results.statement: sc-lint's setup command must itself run atm-core's setup step, building .bootstrap-venv by running just bootstrap, so atm-core's Justfile glue no longer has to.
results.quote:
atm-core can delete its Justfile glue (_py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix, _sc-lint-clippy) because sc-lint runs the setup step and uses the right Python itself.
Definition question (team-lead, 2026-10-30): "does \"the setup step\" mean building `.bootstrap-venv` by running `just bootstrap`?" Rand: "yes"
results.context: Phase M planning; Rand approved the sentence and answered 'yes' to the definition question, relayed by team-lead 2026-10-30
results.deterministic_check: A setup test with a configured just bootstrap stub shows sc-lint setup runs it itself, before provisioning.

criteria.yes: The work concerns sc-lint setup/provisioning, consumer [tool.sc-lint].setup configuration, or the just setup flow.

relevant.instructions: Would carrying out the work in `item.text` touch the setup flow or consumer setup configuration governed by ANC-023? Judge overlap, independent of whether it follows the directive.
